body.name: \(\mathfrak R\)
body.construction: Supply binary encodings of \(n,J,K,w_{\max}\), rational \(\alpha,\gamma,\zeta,\overline\varepsilon_n\), and the rational endpoints of \(\mathcal H\). Supply \(\mathfrak O\) as seven total interval oracles which, for every integer \(m\ge0\), halt with outward rational intervals of width at most \(2^{-m}\) containing the coordinates of \(p\), the coordinates of \(b\), \(v_{\min}\), \(v_{\max}\), \(p_{\min}\), \(\beta\), and the displayed computable bound \(\varepsilon_n\). Certify \(\overline\varepsilon_n\ge\varepsilon_n\) by checking it against the upper endpoint returned by \(\mathfrak o_\varepsilon\). Cover the optimized covariance domain by a rational symmetric-matrix box, discard only boxes whose disjointness from \(v_{\min}I_d\preceq V\preceq v_{\max}I_d\) has a directed-rounding certificate, and retain every undecided box in the outer cover used for the least-favorable optimization.
